principles: Fix at the source: correct where the hash is first computed (snapshot) so both the run fields and the workspaceBinding are right, rather than patching one downstream field.
Backward compatibility by defaulting: metadataRoot defaults to projectRoot so plain repos and existing positional callers stay byte-identical.
Single authoritative metadataRoot: the persisted workspaceBinding.metadataRoot is the source of truth for consumer-side recompute.
Symmetry with existing correct consumers: match how done-oracle/done-prepare/verifier already thread metadataRoot.
Evidence over assertion: a durable red test must fail pre-fix and pass post-fix, plus a byte-identical guard for the default case.
drivers: Correctness of the REVIEW->TEST freshness gate on wrapper-root + custom-storyDir layouts.
Consistency of review-run hash semantics with the DONE gate / quorum / validation.
Zero regression for the overwhelmingly common plain-repo / default-storyDir case.
Minimal, auditable diff that a reviewer can verify against the confirmed spike.

options.name: A: two-sided metadataRoot threading (snapshot + consumers)
pros: Fixes both the wrong signed snapshot AND the wrong freshness recompute; the two sides stay consistent.
Defaulting metadataRoot=projectRoot keeps plain repos byte-identical.
Uses the already-persisted workspaceBinding.metadataRoot; matches done-gate precedent.
Small, localized diff in three files.
cons: Signatures of any pre-existing wrapper-root+custom-storyDir runs change (they were wrong before) — requires an explicit regression guard.
Touches a signing path, so needs careful byte-identical verification.

options.name: B: rely on the existing buildReviewRunWorkspaceBinding fallback (stop passing storyFilesHash)
pros: Smaller change to the binding builder alone.
cons: Only fixes storyFilesHash, not materialHash (which has no fallback).
Leaves the run's own materialHash/storyFilesHash wrong and the two consumer freshness sites wrong.
Does not restore consistency with the DONE gate; the false-stale persists on the material path.

options.name: C: consumer-only fix (thread metadataRoot into the two freshness checks, leave snapshot as-is)
pros: Even smaller diff; no signing-path change.
cons: The signed snapshot remains wrong, so run.materialHash/storyFilesHash still fold in custom-storyDir metadata; freshness would compare a correct recompute against a wrong stored value -> still stale.
Does not fix the production-side defect at all.

rationale: Only option A fixes both the production snapshot (materialHash has no fallback, so B/C leave it wrong) and the consumer recompute, restoring consistency with the DONE gate while defaulting metadataRoot=projectRoot for byte-identical plain-repo behavior. The spike independently confirmed A is minimal, backward-compatible, and uses the already-persisted workspaceBinding.metadataRoot.

preMortem.scenario: A plain-repo review run's signature changes, breaking existing DONE/quorum evidence.
preMortem.trigger: metadataRoot not defaulted to projectRoot, or the signing payload reordered.
preMortem.consequence: Every existing review run verifies as tampered; REVIEW->TEST gate blocks everywhere.
preMortem.mitigation: Default metadataRoot=projectRoot in captureReviewRunSnapshot/diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot; regression guard asserts default-case snapshot + signReviewRun byte-identical to pre-change output.

preMortem.scenario: Consumer recompute uses a metadataRoot inconsistent with what the snapshot was signed under.
preMortem.trigger: Consumer sources metadataRoot from something other than run.workspaceBinding.metadataRoot (e.g. re-resolving live), diverging from the signed value.
preMortem.consequence: materialHash recompute won't match the stored hash even for a clean tree -> new false stale.
preMortem.mitigation: Consumer uses run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot (the persisted, signed value); test asserts clean-tree freshness on the exact wrapper-root layout.

preMortem.scenario: Legacy runs without a workspaceBinding regress.
preMortem.trigger: Consumer unconditionally reads run.workspaceBinding.metadataRoot and it is undefined.
preMortem.consequence: metadataRoot becomes undefined -> loadConfig(undefined) resolves from cwd -> wrong exclusion -> stale for legacy runs.
preMortem.mitigation: Use `?? projectRoot` fallback; add a legacy-run (no binding) test asserting unchanged behavior.

preMortem.scenario: diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot left un-threaded diverges from captureReviewRunSnapshot.
preMortem.trigger: Only captureReviewRunSnapshot gets metadataRoot; the diagnostic EMPTY_MATERIAL_HASH check still computes from projectRoot.
preMortem.consequence: Inconsistent materialHash interpretation between diagnosis and capture on wrapper-root; confusing false 'missing_material_hash' or masked errors.
preMortem.mitigation: Thread metadataRoot into diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot too (spike caveat), even though it only affects the diagnostic path.
